name: centry-nhr-tax-calculator
description:
Compare category-by-category tax assumptions, household cashflow and preparation dates around the supplied end of an NHR period. Edit spending and income scenarios and export a specialist-ready brief.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

No final tax bill or NHR entitlement is determined. Supplied rates remain assumptions; the narrow IRS illustration excludes credits, minimum-existence relief, solidarity surcharge, joint assessment, social security and other-income aggregation. Only illustrative effective-rate scenarios for pensions, rent, dividends and other income; no NHR category treatment is inferred. 2026 basic IRS mode is narrow and excludes credits, minimum-existence relief, solidarity surcharge, joint assessment, social security and other-income aggregation. Future tax law, residence, treaty treatment and household affordability require individual confirmation.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

positive.description: Open the NHR Tax Calculator workspace
positive.prompt: Open Centry NHR Tax Calculator to compare my supplied household assumptions before and after an NHR period.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Centry NHR Tax Calculator workspace. Return productId nhr-tax-calculator, kind open, required input questions and scope limitations. Do not insert fictional customer facts or require a booking.

positive.description: Synthetic — Portuguese household pension and dividends after NHR
positive.prompt:
Compare this fictional pension-and-dividend household budget using the explicit before-and-after tax-rate assumptions. Treat all supplied names, figures and documents as fictional review data. Use these complete inputs without adding facts:
{"finalYear":2026,"statusConfirmed":"unknown","comparisonYear":2027,"region":"mainland","income":[{"label":"Alex — pension","category":"pension","cash":50000,"basis":50000,"currentRate":10,"afterRate":25,"method":"supplied rate"},{"label":"Sam — dividends","category":"dividend","cash":20000,"basis":20000,"currentRate":0,"afterRate":28,"method":"supplied rate"}],"monthlySpending":3800,"otherAnnualCosts":2000,"rateNotes":"Synthetic household. Supplied rates remain assumptions; the narrow IRS illustration excludes credits, minimum-existence relief, solidarity surcharge, joint assessment, social security and other-income aggregation.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry NHR Tax Calculator: Compare category-by-category tax assumptions, household cashflow and preparation dates around the supplied end of an NHR period. Edit spending and income scenarios and export a specialist-ready brief. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
